name: HIST 6850
title: American Studies: Keywords
description: (Also offered as AMST 6850, ENGL 6850.) Detailed study of a specific topic in American cultural studies with an emphasis on developing skills in interdisciplinary research. Topics vary from semester to semester. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in English, History, and Political Science; open to others with consent.
